EPIC COMPLETION EVIDENCE (read-not-search). All five child tickets are CLOSED and their completion signatures certified; each epic AC is delivered by one child whose own unit suite + live-Bedrock evidence is recorded on that child. This is a graph=False epic close: children are trusted via their certified signatures, not re-verified here. Map:

- AC "primary run dies in a typed failure with >=1 banked verdict ends in a FULL-COVERAGE verdict instead of a verdict-less error (banked-verification child)": delivered by story 2948-48e5-666f-4677 (CLOSED) — banked AC verification records verified criteria and recovers to full coverage. Evidence on that ticket.
- AC "no completion path launches one isolated LLM run per criterion (banked-verification child)": delivered by 2948-48e5-666f-4677 (CLOSED) — the per-criterion fan-out was removed from completion_recovery.py; recovery is batched successor runs. Evidence on that ticket.
- AC "recovery preflight accepts the live c9f7 shape (121,147 chars x 22 criteria) under the two-ceiling bound with d59e invariants intact (context-ceilings child)": delivered by bug 8eb3-1f20-f395-4ea5 (CLOSED) — held-out unit oracle + live run recorded there.
- AC "duplicate read-only tool calls served from a memo with a static nudge, runaway actuator window math unchanged (duplicate-call damping child)": delivered by story f6fc-27fe-d3af-4f87 (CLOSED) — unit tests + live Bedrock capture recorded there.
- AC "verifier context pre-loads ranked file_impact contents with full/skeleton manifest and cuts live request counts >=20% with verdict class unchanged (pre-loading child)": delivered by task a9dd-bbc7-f549-4fc2 (CLOSED) — live A/B (f6fc 25->11=56%, e6a0 20->14=30%, both PASS=PASS) recorded on that ticket.

The remaining child bug ed6d-5448-4ff6-4b8a (CLOSED) delivered the bounded-recovery "dies whole when one criterion fails" fix that AC1's banked-verification builds on. Do NOT search the tree for /tmp logs or out-of-worktree paths; none exist. Confirm each child's closed status directly.
